Name: modding Discord Farm
Author: JessebotX
Description:
[color=#ffff00][b]DISCLAIMER: its a screenshot of that time, its not actually showing active conversations. That would be spyware.[/b][/color]
Brought you by the creator of the legendary Color Valley map recolour mod, this mod will bring #modding from the SDV discord to your farm... literally.

[u][b][size=6]Features
[/size][/b][/u][list]
[*]Replaces Standard Farm
[*]Buildable and Diggable tiles
[*]Water tiles (visit [font=Courier New]droeew[/font])
[*]Basically works/includes the same things in every farm map
[*][font=Courier New]#modding[/font] brought to your farm!
[/list]
[b][u][size=6]Install[/size][/u][/b][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI (2.11 +)[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher (1.8 +)[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod, unzip/extract into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[/list]
[u]To... [/u] ﻿
[list]
[*][b]Disable temporarily: one of the following...[/b]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿1. Move mod out of mods folder
﻿ ﻿2. Rename mod folder with a [font=Courier New].[/font] in front (eg. [font=Courier New].[CP] #modding Farm[/font] (Windows users may need to rename it to[font=Courier New] .[CP] #modding Farm.[/font]) )[list]
[*][b]Update: ﻿[/b]replace its files with the new versions.
[*][b]Uninstall: [/b]delete the mod folder from the [code]Mods[/code] folder to uninstall it.
[/list]See [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Player's Guide to Downloading and Using Mods[/url]﻿ if you need more help

[b][u][size=6]Compatibility
[/size][/u]> Works on singleplayer and multiplayer:[/b]
These are only visible to players who install them. Players without the custom map will see the normal map and will be subject to the normal
bounds.
[b]> Other mods compatibility:
[/b]Works with almost any mod as long as it doesn't replace the standard farm map
